opportunities.title: Sort bulky waste into recoverable fractions
opportunities.summary: Separate suitable wood, inert material, metal and plastic objects on a prepared sorting line.

reviewLinks.rationale: Exact configured sorting system is described for this material workflow.
limitations: Requires feed preparation and fraction-specific testing.

opportunities.title: Recover light recyclables from residue belts
opportunities.summary: Pick target packaging and light objects from a prepared reject or side-stream conveyor.

reviewLinks.rationale: Exact configured sorting system is described for this material workflow.
limitations: One-kilogram object limit; suitable geometry and presentation required.

opportunities.title: Recover beverage cartons from paper lines
opportunities.summary: Identify and lift target cartons from a dry paper/fibre conveyor with trained operators maintaining the cell.

reviewLinks.rationale: Exact configured sorting system is described for this material workflow.
limitations: Dust control, material distribution and gripper maintenance affect results.
